title: The information cost of boundary-free weak estimation under correlated noise - code and synthetic-data archive
description: Exact weak adjoint-range geometry, a constructive full-library small-noise efficiency theorem under a nonzero jet condition, and reproducible correlated-noise benchmarks. Includes core submission supplement and separate historical research extensions. Frozen independent small-noise size and power checks retain all successful and failed criteria. Moderate-noise bootstrap validation is incomplete following a recorded compute-budget decision. No journal submission or acceptance is asserted.
